title: Cruz Azul and Toluca Draw 3-3 and Share Points in Liga MX
seoTitle: Cruz Azul and Toluca Draw 3-3 in Liga MX
subtitle: Matchday 10 clash ended in a draw, keeping Toluca at the top of the standings
excerpt: In Matchday 10 of Liga MX, Cruz Azul and Toluca shared points in a 3-3 draw, with the Toluca machine reclaiming the top of the table.
author: Daniele Morais
trending: classificações de cruz azul x toluca
contentHtml:
On Matchday 10 of Liga MX, Cruz Azul and Toluca played out a thrilling 3-3 draw, keeping Toluca at the top of the standings. The result generated great interest among fans closely following the battle for the top spot.

How the Match Unfolded

Cruz Azul opened the scoring in the first half, netting two goals and controlling the pace of the game. The team seemed headed for victory when, in the 55th minute, Toluca found the equalizer.

Second-Half Turnaround

In the second half, Toluca applied pressure and, in the 78th minute, scored their third goal, overturning Cruz Azul's lead. In stoppage time, Cruz Azul fought back and secured their third goal, sealing the final 3-3 draw.

Impact on the Standings

With the draw, Cruz Azul reached 16 points, while Toluca climbed to 20 points, remaining at the top of the Liga MX table. The result kept the narrow margin between the two clubs in the title race.

Refereeing in the Spotlight

The next match between the teams will be officiated by Katia Itzel García, who was previously involved in an incident with coach Antonio “Turco” Mohamed on Matchday 8. On that occasion, Mohamed approached the fourth official during the match against Atlas, causing a stir. Now, García will serve as the main referee, while Mohamed will lead from the Toluca bench.

Expectations for the Next Encounter

The rematch between Cruz Azul and Toluca promises another intense duel, with Katia Itzel García's refereeing adding an extra element of attention to the clash. Both teams will look to improve their position in the table, keeping the race tight until the end of the season.
